nobox.final_span:
the debut of rookie Filip Zadina, who made the Wings after training camp following what anyone would consider a successful season in Grand Rapids. His 44 goals, 81 points and team MVP award distinguish him as a 27th overall pick deserving of his price tag. For the Wings, who might have an opportunity to retain their young goalie with an additional spot this season, Zadina seems worth the investment.
Here’s what to look out for, plus on debut.
News and notes: Do you recall those bus trips when Zadina would accompany defenseman Filip Hronek to and from games in Grand Rapids? That no longer happens, as Zadina now gets a drive to and from Grand Rapids from Joe Louis Arena.
